mo_ta_cong_viec:
Our client, a leading international Japanese IT solutions provider, is seeking a proactive Bridge System Engineer (BrSE) specializing in .NET / C#. In this key position, you will act as the vital communication and technical bridge, converting complex client expectations into successful technical execution by local development teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Communicate directly with Japanese stakeholders to clarify, analyze, and define project requirements and functional specifications.
Translate business requirements and technical documents between Japanese and local development teams accurately.
Participate in system design, architecture planning, and core code reviews using .NET and C# technologies.
Oversee development progress, manage technical risks, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain strict quality standards throughout the SDLC.
Facilitate regular project meetings, Q&A sessions, and status reporting with client management.
Support project estimation, technical feasibility studies, and team coordination.
yeu_cau:
Must Have:
Solid track record serving as a Bridge System Engineer (BrSE) or Technical Lead in software development projects.
3 years of experience as a BrSE or equivalent position in a Japanese outsourcing project.
Strong technical background in .NET / C# stack (ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Entity Framework, SQL Server).
Japanese language proficiency equivalent to JLPT N2 or N1, with fluent spoken and written communication for technical discussions.
Hands-on experience creating software design documentation (Basic Design, Detailed Design, System Flowcharts).
Exceptional analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and strong cross-cultural communication abilities.Nice to Have:
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS.
Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js).
Agile/Scrum development experience or formal project management certification.
quyen_loi:

Direct opportunities to travel, train, or take on short-term/long-term onsite assignments in Japan.
